title: IEX arm applies for coal exchange licence

timeline.title: IEX arm applies for coal exchange licence
timeline.line: A ₹100 cr subsidiary has applied to the Coal Controller to run physical coal trading
more: It filed on Sept 25; the subsidiary was set up on June 1
The aim is to capture coal trading as e-auctions phase out
